# Benjy Larcher

> Benjy Larcher is a senior full-stack software engineer experienced in leading teams and shipping end-to-end products: microservices and DevOps, 3D rendering (Three.js), Web3 integrations and real-time systems.

## Experience

- 2025 - present: Senior Full Stack Developer at Authi.com
- 2022 - 2025: Senior Full Stack Developer at Cyberbrokers.com
- 2020 - 2022: Product Owner and Full Stack Developer at Voxels.com (formerly Cryptovoxels)
- Master in Finance, Massey University, Auckland (2018 - 2020); Bachelor in Economics, University of Otago (2013 - 2016)

## Skills

- Languages: TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, Kotlin, Go, C#, Solidity
- Frameworks: React, React Native, Next.js, Vue.js, GraphQL, Web3, Spring Boot, Node / Bun
- Platforms: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), Google Cloud, Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Vercel, Prometheus, Grafana
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase

## Projects

- [TongueUp](https://tongueup.benjylarcher.com/): free Android app that reminds you to keep good tongue posture
- [SkyBuds](https://skybuds.benjylarcher.com): personal project combining Three.js, NFTs and serverless functions
- [RendrGen](https://rendrgen.com/): affordable renders of digital assets for portfolios and listings
